summary: Platform and trailer at Salmon River Ridge (1965), then a 2-story DNR cab (1967); moved to Buckley's Foothills museum grounds in 2000; cab was closed on a 2021 visit.

access.note: Museum exhibit in Van Hoof Park, Buckley. Ask the museum about hours and whether the cab is open; a 2021 visitor found it closed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The site histories date the platform to 1965 and the 2-story cab to 1967. A quoted state report dates a tower erected between 1966 and 1968. The story gives both and keeps 1965 and 1967 as the main dates.
WillhiteWeb says North River Road; the blog says N River Avenue. The story uses the WillhiteWeb name only.

sources.title: Salmon River Lookout - Buckley Foothills Museum

notes_for_editor: Only the 2021 blog says the Quinault Nation donated the cab in 2000; the other sources say only that it was moved. Museum hours and current condition are not verified; the museum homepage we read had no lookout detail. The county in the record (Pierce) is for the current site and was not checked against a source; the original site is in Grays Harbor County per Former Fire Lookout Sites. The access level 'public' is inferred from the museum park setting and one visit.
